name: Show timeline: following a musical clock
description: A fake MIDI clock (fed through the real chase controller, sink and show store) rolls at 132 BPM against a 120 BPM map: the show follows at the source tempo with the song's rate set to match and no reseeks; a parked locate parks it; while parked the playhead can be moved and Stop goes to 0.

steps.label: Rolling at 132 against 120: the show follows, 10% fast, with no reseeks

eval.true.js: (() => { const s = __show.show(); const g = window.__fakeGen; const st = __show.read(__show.g().showControl.timecodeChase.status); return s.isPlaying && s.currentTime > 4 + 2 * 1.1 - 0.4 && s.currentTime < 4 + 2 * 1.1 + 0.4 && st.mismatch === true && g.length > 60 && g[g.length - 1] === g[10]; })()
eval.true.label: playing near 6.2 s, mismatch shown, seek generation steady after the start
